_schema: Room content. The renderer's trust boundary, enforced in room.js:
_plain: PLAIN TEXT, escaped on render: cards[].name, groups[].title, groups[].symbols[].n
_raw: RAW AUTHORED HTML, injected as-is: cards[].body, cards[].note, examples[].q, examples[].steps[], examples[].ans, groups[].symbols[].g
_rule: Anything moved between those two lists changes what the browser does with it. Plain fields must never contain markup; raw fields are trusted and must never hold anything a reader typed.

cards.name: Controls
cards.body: Positive & negative controls · vehicle · blinding · randomization.

cards.name: Variables
cards.body: Independent (you change) · dependent (you measure) · controlled (held constant) · confounders.

cards.name: Replicates
cards.body: Technical (same sample, repeated) vs biological (independent samples). Report n.

cards.name: Mean, SD, SEM
cards.body: x̄ = Σx/n · SD = spread · SEM = SD/√n (precision of the mean).

cards.name: Error & uncertainty
cards.body: Random (scatter, reduce with n) vs systematic (bias). Report value ± uncertainty.

cards.name: Significant figures
cards.body: Keep the digits the measurement supports; the result is only as precise as its least-precise input.

cards.name: SI base units
cards.body: metre (m) · kilogram (kg) · second (s) · ampere (A) · kelvin (K) · mole (mol) · candela (cd).

cards.name: Scientific notation
cards.body: a × 10<sup>n</sup>, with 1 ≤ |a| < 10. Add/subtract: match exponents; multiply: add exponents.

cards.name: Unit conversion
cards.body: Multiply by 1 in disguise (e.g. 1000 mg / 1 g); cancel units; check the result's units.

cards.name: Common constants
cards.body: N<sub>A</sub> = 6.022×10²³ /mol · R = 8.314 J/mol·K · k<sub>B</sub> = 1.38×10⁻²³ J/K · c = 3.00×10⁸ m/s.

cards.name: Chemistry notation
cards.body: H₂O · Na⁺ · Cl⁻ · ΔG · K · pH · mol/L · e⁻ · subscripts (count) & superscripts (charge).

cards.name: Biology notation
cards.body: DNA / RNA · A–T, G–C · 5′→3′ · genotype/phenotype · [S], K<sub>m</sub>, V<sub>max</sub>.

cards.name: Ephys notation
cards.body: V<sub>m</sub> · E<sub>ion</sub> · pA · mV · MΩ · pF · ms · τ · R<sub>a</sub> · R<sub>m</sub>.
